cases.request: Analyze why a merchant's card authorization rate is declining.

intent_selection.rationale: Portfolio authorization-rate deterioration needs cohort denominators, retries and causal hypotheses. Single-payment traces and supplied error-log counts can supply evidence but cannot complete the aggregate analysis.

limitations: Later-phase capability; installed supporting evidence tasks do not complete this requested job.

cases.request: Compare FedNow, RTP, ACH, and card rails for a specific use case.

intent_selection.rationale: Bank workflow design is a sensible lead for FedNow, RTP and ACH. The requested card comparison also needs card lifecycle/acceptance evidence; the bank designer explicitly has only bank-rail profiles.
intent_selection.gap: No native card-rail comparison profile in the selected bank-rail target; keep card leg unresolved rather than silently dropping it.

limitations: Initial US, euro-area and UK analysis/planning; national and institution overlays remain required.

cases.request: Develop an AI strategy for payment operations.
